commands.label: Execute the compiled sample in the genuine Garmin simulator on an isolated virtual display

isolated-simulator.sh.content_utf8:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
python3 -I -c 'import socket,fcntl,struct; s=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_DGRAM); q=struct.pack("16sH22x",b"lo",0); r=fcntl.ioctl(s.fileno(),0x8913,q); fcntl.ioctl(s.fileno(),0x8914,struct.pack("16sH22x",b"lo",struct.unpack_from("H",r,16)[0]|1))'
simulator=$1
launcher=$2
result=$3
profile=$4
"$simulator" > simulator.log 2>&1 &
pid=$!
trap 'kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; tail -60 simulator.log' EXIT
sleep 5
"$launcher" "$result" "$profile"

toolchain: Garmin Connect IQ 8.4.1 compiler and native fenix7 simulator
reproduction_command: monkeyc -f monkey.jungle -d fenix7 -g -o greeting.prg -y <ephemeral DER key>; monkeydo greeting.prg fenix7
semantic_scope: The official compiler built the exact project against the recorded fenix7 profile. The official isolated simulator ran it and emitted the exact greeting.
